The '''White Thranta Shipping offices''' was a bunker on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that served as the headquarters of the [[White Thranta Shipping Company]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:SD" />

==Description==
{{Quote|There's a shipping company just outside of Mos Eisley called White Thranta. I have information that leads me to believe they aren't a simple shipping company.|[[Reimos Taligg]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DI" />}}
[[File:WhiteThranta2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The first section of the headquarters gave the shipping company the appearance of a normal operation.]]
The White Thranta Shipping offices was a bunker located on the eastern outskirts of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The headquarters was operated by a shipping company used by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] as a criminal front organization.<ref name="SWG:DI" /> The White Thranta bunker served as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] base of operations and most of the goods shipped were destined to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|329|White Thranta}}</ref>

A large number of security guards patrolled the area<ref name="SWG:DI" /> and the security personnel used a modified version of a popular [[Sg-82 sonic rifle]].<ref name="WTR">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=White Thranta Rifle}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Jabba contacted me directly about the future of this facility. He was asking some very strange questions. I'm starting to think someone is aware of my plans and are telling them to Jabba. I need to speed up the take-over timetable.|[[Brok Ziam]]'s journal|<ref name="SWG:SO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Shipping Out|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], members of the White Thranta Shipping Company including [[Brok Ziam]] and [[Durr Roddack]], got involved in questionable medical activities.<ref name="SWG:DI" /> They performed unethical experiments on sapient races in the bunker bellow the White Thranta offices,<ref name="SWG:DP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Data Purge|Tatooine}}</ref> without Jabba being aware of it.<ref name="SWG:JDW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Jabba's Dirty Work|Tatooine}}</ref> In total, White Thranta had kidnapped and infected at least 41 victims for medical experiment, including [[Dakk Jenzik]], [[Leon Kovalski]], [[Tork Magzyn]] and a woman named [[Dina (individual)|Dina]].<ref name="SWG:DI" />

[[File:WhiteThranta3.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The deep recesses of the headquarters offered a glimpse of illegal experimentation in one of the complex's medical bays.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Jabba's employee [[Reimos Taligg]] tasked spacers to slice the computers of the White Thranta bunker, eventually discovering the situation.<ref name="SWG:DI" /> Reimos then requested the spacers to attack the offices and kill Durr Roddack and Brok Ziam.<ref name="SWG:SO" />

Around the same time, a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] went to the White Thranta offices in order to execute the indebted [[Untas]].<ref name="SWG:FJ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Faeto's Job|Tatooine}}</ref> In the meantime, a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] working for [[Kaesii DuPree]] infiltrated the base to recover the plans for a military prototype [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] stolen by Durr Roddack.<ref name="SWG:SLU">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Spy|Spies Like Us|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The White Thranta Shipping offices was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:SD" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The White Thranta Shipping offices was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

In the cut quests "Opening Moves" and "Information Control," the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Aigorn]] would have tasked the player with eliminating one of the medical staff in the White Thranta infirmary and steal medical data.<ref name="File1">{{GalaxiesNGE}} &mdash; tatooine_eisley_epidemic.stf, tatooine_eisley_aigorn.stf, tatooine_eisley_information_control.stf</ref> In another cut quest, the woman [[Kashi VanDeef]] would have requested the player to rescue her husband [[Pilar VanDeef|Pilar]] from the White Thranta.<ref name="File2">{{GalaxiesNGE}} &mdash; tatooine_eisley_kashi.stf</ref>
